## Requirements (contract)

1. **Sink.** `object_type='entity_ref'` claims with `object_entity`, through P31.3's `object_resolver` seam (wired in
   production, not redesigned); partner schemes join `GUARDED_SCHEMES` with their backfill in the same change;
   `claim.sql` checks honoured; additive — the text claims are unchanged and the entity-ref claim is a separate
   record with its own digest (the resolver returns `None` for the text record).
2. **Partner org identity (ADR-R9-ENTITYREF).** One scheme: crosswalk ids when present, else a normalized-name id via
   `normalize_org_name`; `entity_type='organization'` via `EntityRef.entity_type` + an `organization` row /
   `cached_canonical_name`; ambiguity rule (unresolvable/ambiguous → text only); never-a-person rule (person- or
   sole-proprietor-shaped → text only), test-pinned.
3. **Emitters.** Procurement + accountability connectors emit entity-ref claims for the partner predicates (list
   re-confirmed from the connector inventory); same evidence locators as the text claim.
4. **Registry.** Procurement + accountability predicates in `predicates.yaml`: object kind, strategy, volatility,
   directness for their genres; mapped onto existing rows where the meaning is equal; `make gen` + `verify-gen`,
   `ontology/generated` committed.
5. **Fixture proof.** Over committed fixtures: shadow-replay diff 0 for the text claims; entity-ref claims emitted;
   P28.2/P28.6 materializers over real-PG sink-written claims → > 0 edges and links, +0 re-run.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1: the sink writes `object_entity` claims; text claims unchanged (shadow diff 0).
- AC2: ambiguous and person-shaped partners stay text-only (test-pinned).
- AC3: predicates registered; `make gen` + `make verify-gen` clean, generated artifacts committed.
- AC4: over fixtures the edge + accountability materializers produce > 0 rows from emitted claims, re-run +0 (real PG).
- AC5: ADR with `## Revisit trigger` + Appendix F row; `make check` + `make test-db` green; D-P30.2-2 stays OPEN with
  a note.

Out of scope (confirmed not done): hosted replay/materialization, access-edge records (flock_portal /
audit_structural `configured_access_edge`), cross-source org ER beyond the deterministic identifier, person entities.

## Plan

(see Progress; recorded at plan time)

- **Inventory re-confirmation** (connector code + `reports/p30.2a-hosted/predicate_inventory_before.json`): partner
  predicates actually emitted are procurement `buyer` / `seller` / `recipient` / `funder` (Contract,
  FundingInstrument, SAM, USAspending, TED, portal notices; France DECP via `Contract`) and accountability
  `event_organizations`. **No procurement/accountability path emits `applies_to` or `operator`.** The operator
  relation the P28.6 chain needs (deployment → org) is emitted by `dot_511` as `camera_operator` (the reviewed,
  per-target publisher name) — included; OSM `operator_stated` is excluded (ODbL compartment + crowd free text,
  an ask-first boundary). `proceeding_parties` excluded (litigants are routinely natural persons, Part VIII).
- `resolution/partner_identity.py` (+ `data/partner_identity.toml`): pure partner-org identity — crosswalk id or
  `sig.org.name` normalized name; ambiguity + never-a-person rules; `partner_ref_rows()` builds the entity-ref twin.
- Connectors override `link()` (the framework's identity seam) to append twins: procurement, France procurement,
  accountability, dot_511.
- `db`: `EntityRef.label` (optional); `record_object_ref()` production resolver; organization row for newly
  resolved partner orgs; `GUARDED_SCHEMES` += partner schemes; sqitch `partner_org_identity_key` (backfill + check);
  `connectors.sinks.make_claim_sink('pg')` wires the resolver.
- Readers: P28.6 assembler recognises `camera_operator` / `event_organizations`, treats connector-placeholder
  `deployment` subjects of contract/funding-domain predicates as contracts/funding (never as anchors), drops
  `seller` from the direct-vendor set (a contract predicate); exports `sharing_edges` excludes partner predicates.
- Registry rows (46) with `object_kind` + `maps_to`; SKOS carries `sig:objectKind` / `sig:mapsTo`.
- ADR-112 + Appendix F row + BUILD.sh.

## Progress

- Phase 0 done: branch created, deferrals + contract + anchors read.
- Phase 1.2 baseline: `pytest` at base `34406ff` (separate worktree, no `web/node_modules`) → 4,082 passed /
  6 skipped (the three extra skips are the web-build e2e checks that need npm).
- Phase 2 done: identity module + data, sink (`record_object_ref`, `EntityRef.label`, organisation rows, person
  refusal), guard schemes + sqitch `partner_org_identity_key`, `link()` emitters (procurement, France procurement,
  accountability, dot_511), factory wiring, P28.6 reader, export `sharing_edges` filter, 46 registry rows + SKOS,
  `make gen`; tests: `tests/resolution/test_partner_identity.py` (49), `tests/connectors/test_partner_refs_shadow.py`
  (5), `tests/db/test_partner_entity_refs.py` (6, real PG), `test_dot_511` + `test_camera_predicates` updated for
  the additive twin / the assessed rows. Golden digests generated at `34406ff` by running the unchanged harness in
  a base worktree.
- Design decisions made mid-implementation (recorded in ADR-112): `Department of <sector>` names are generic
  (federal agencies are identified by the agency-code crosswalk, not the name); single words stay text; Polish `ł`
  is a recall cost of `normalize_org_name` v1; accountability events are typed by predicate domain too.

- Phase 3 (independent fresh-context review, read-only subagent over spec + diff + ledger): 2 blockers, 4
  should-fix, 5 nits. **B1** two-letter legal forms (`SA`/`SE`/`AG`/`AS`/…) minted `Kim Se-hoon`, `Jose Sa`;
  **B2** title + name minted (`Sheriff John Smith`, `Police Chief Jane Doe`); **S1** sole-proprietor trade names
  minted (`John Smith Consulting`); **S2** place-less names merged across jurisdictions (`Fire Department`,
  `Housing Authority`); **S3** `publication_review_required` written but unread; **S4** factory wiring + new
  registry fields untested; **N1** rules version not in `identity_basis`; N2 first-label-wins; N3 pre-existing
  `%`-placeholder bug on the export belief path; N4 test exemption by `object_kind`; N5 no `sig_ingest` grant on
  `organization`. **Closed:** B1 (two-letter forms dropped), B2 (role/title words refuse without a head noun),
  S1 (a reviewed given-name list, place names omitted), S2 (a distinguishing word is required; service nouns
  generic) — every probe pinned as a refusal in `tests/resolution/test_partner_identity.py`; S4 (factory test +
  registry field test); N1 (`EntityRef.rules` → `identity_basis.rules`, DB-asserted); N4 (explicit set).
  **Recorded:** S3 → D-P31.5-2 (read surfaces, P31.6/P31.16); N2 in ADR-112 consequences (hosted label order);
  N3 pre-existing, not touched (outside scope; the new `NOT IN` list has no `%`); N5 matches existing practice
  (`entity_identifier` has no `sig_ingest` grant either; hosted ingest runs as the schema owner).
- Phase 4 gap walk (fresh re-read of the contract) → table below. `make check` then surfaced two collisions of the
  new registry rows: SIG-STORE-046 (six Appendix C.4 typing columns now share a predicate name → reviewed
  allowlist, as ADR-104 did for `external_id`) and the France seed (`instrument_type` in `agency_policy` read D6
  → D2, a §11.14 instrument's own record states its type). Both closed and recorded in ADR-112.
